description: Late-Victorian six-shot service revolver (break-top type), 0.26 m, lying on its right side on the floor, muzzle to +X, grip to -X and +Y (its top edge toward -Y): round 4-inch barrel with a top rib and blade foresight, fluted cylinder with six chambers, frame with a barrel latch, spurred hammer, curved trigger in a round guard, bird's-head grip with chequered walnut panels and a lanyard ring.
